result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible content and layout issues, mainly duplicated listings and horizontally clipped content.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” section shows two apparently identical Green Bowl Poké cards with the same image, delivery time, and delivery fee, making the content look duplicated.
issues.suggestion: Verify the restaurant data and replace the duplicate card with the correct listing, or intentionally differentiate the cards if they represent separate locations.

issues.description: The horizontal category and restaurant carousels show partially cut-off items at the right edge, including a sliver of an additional category and a truncated “Smash Bros Bu...” card title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels have clear scroll affordance and adequate edge padding, or constrain the visible cards so text is not awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower portion of the next restaurant card, leaving its image and content visibly cut off at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding or adjust the fixed navigation layering so cards can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
